title: 第1312章 暴揍十阶侯爷两章合一第1311章 亲临玉京皇都两章合一
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 林羽在隔壁原本是嗑着瓜子，饶有兴致的在听着皇城中的桃色趣事，不曾想那两人说着说着将他牵扯了进去，还被人辱骂了一通。
这让他如何能忍？
一道金光飞过，天鹏动了。
伴随着包厢的隔断炸开，天缺府公子瞬间横飞了出去，发出了一声惨叫。
这突如其来的变化，让不少强者纷纷一震。
在他们的神念之下，看到了一切。
一只金色的鸟踩着了天缺府的公子，不断蹂躏，同时口中还在骂骂咧咧：“嘴巴不干净是吧？那就让鹏爷给你涮涮嘴。”
天鹏一只金色的爪子上浮现大道神纹，将青年一爪子按在了脚下，难以动弹一分。
同时。
他的另一只金色爪子直接伸进了青年的口中一顿搅动。
伴随着鲜血流出，青年疼得撕心裂肺的大叫了起来。
这残忍血腥的一幕，让神念看到的人全都吞了吞口水。
“这是哪里来的凶禽，好残忍！”
但紧接着，他们透过天鹏崩裂的包厢隔断，看到了其内缓缓夹菜的林羽，心中已然明白。
这青年才是那凶禽的主人。
只是……
这到底是何人？竟然敢在皇都中对天缺府的公子做出这般惨绝人寰的事情。
“啊啊啊……”
惨叫声不断。
这凄厉的声音，让那位之前在针锋相对的王昆都是脸色一变。
他虽然与对方不和，但也不敢如此行事啊！
先不说对方背后站着天缺王府，当是这顺天酒楼就很不简单，背后的势力滔天，令诸多王侯都有些忌惮。
已经有近十年没有人敢在这酒楼中大打出手了，不然纵然是他们这些身份显赫的纨绔子弟，背后有王府撑腰，也免不了要脱一层皮。
“这哪里来的猛人？竟然敢无视一切，在此地动手？打的还是天缺府的公子！”
“不管他是何人，在这里动手就注定要倒霉了，纵然是王府之人也不例外！”
四方不少食客小声的嘀咕。
就在这时。
一道黑衣身影如同鬼魅般出现在了这一楼中，浑身散发着强大的气息，冷喝道：“谁敢在此地撒野？还不住手！”
“酒楼掌柜来了，那只凶禽和那个青年完蛋了。”
酒楼掌柜看向争斗的中心，看清之后眼眸一凝。
“天缺府公子？”
他没想到，争执的两方中的一人，竟然是天缺府公子，而且满嘴鲜血，看上去无比的凄惨。
心中不由一抖。
这要是在酒楼中出了事，那位天缺王不得把此地掀翻？
content_en:
;;
Lin Yu was eating melon seeds next door and listening to the interesting stories in the imperial city with great interest. He never thought that the two people talked about him and got him involved, and he was insulted a lot.
How could he endure this?
"Uh-huh!"
A golden light flew by, and Tianpeng moved.
As the partition of the box exploded, Young Master Tianque Mansion flew out instantly and let out a scream.
This sudden change shocked many powerful people.
Under their spiritual thoughts, they saw everything.
A golden bird stepped on the young master of Tianque Mansion and kept ravaging him, while still cursing: "Your mouth is not clean, isn't it? Then let Master Peng rinse your mouth."
Tianpeng's golden claws showed the divine pattern of the Great Dao, and he pinned the young man's claws under his feet, making it difficult for him to move.
at the same time.
His other golden claw went directly into the young man's mouth and stirred.
As blood flowed out, the young man screamed in heartbreaking pain.
This cruel and bloody scene made everyone who saw it swallow their saliva.
"Where did this vicious bird come from? It's so cruel!"
But then, through the broken partition of Tianpeng's box, they saw Lin Yu slowly picking up food inside, and they already understood in their hearts.
This young man is the master of that fierce bird.
Just...
Who is this? How dare you do such a cruel thing to the young master of Tianque Mansion in the imperial capital.
"Ahhhh..."
The screams continued.
This shrill voice made Wang Kun, who was facing tit-for-tat before, change his expression.
Although he was at odds with the other party, he did not dare to act like this!
Not to mention that the Tianque Palace is standing behind the other party. It is not easy to think of this Shuntian Restaurant. The power behind it is so overwhelming that many princes are a little afraid.
It has been nearly ten years since anyone dared to fight in this restaurant. Otherwise, even if they were prominent playboys with the support of the palace, they would inevitably lose their skin.
"Where did this fierce man come from? How dare you ignore everything and attack here? The one you beat is the young master of Tianque Mansion!"
"No matter who he is, if he takes action here, he is destined to be unlucky, even if he is from the palace!"
Many diners from all directions whispered.
Just then.
A figure in black appeared on this floor like a ghost, exuding a powerful aura, and shouted coldly: "Who dares to run wild here? Stop it!"
"The restaurant owner is here, that vicious bird and that young man are finished."
…
The restaurant owner looked towards the center of the fight, and his eyes narrowed after seeing clearly.
"Master Tianque Mansion?"
He did not expect that one of the two parties to the dispute turned out to be Young Master Tianque Mansion, and his mouth was full of blood, looking extremely miserable.
My heart couldn't help but tremble.
If something happened in the restaurant, wouldn't King Tian Que overturn this place?
